headline: Proving AI Works Before Scaling It
thesis: From EdReports to Brookings to 1EdTech, the message is the same: show the evidence that AI in classrooms improves learning before it scales.
summary: Coverage this week centers on evidence and guardrails for AI. EdSurge's Mike Kentz argues AI tutors build thinking only when the conversation itself is assessed, building on an EdReports finding that just 1 of 10 vendors offered third-party evidence for embedded AI features. Brookings' Global Task Force concludes the risks of generative AI for children currently outweigh the benefits, while Inside Higher Ed data suggests campus AI integration is overhyped. ISTE+ASCD pushes AI literacy training for educators, and Ed-Fi's November 9–11 Summit and 1EdTech's November 12 'Show Me the Evidence' session keep interoperability and proof in focus.
footnote: Compiled from 11 curated edtech sources · NOVEMBER 2, 2026 · Search-snippet based; Education Technology Insights, EdTech Digest, THE Journal and EdTech Magazine had few or no items dated this week, and EdTech Week's October event has concluded.
